notes.subject: רכב
notes.rationale: 'Upper millstone' (KJV/JPS tradition) vs literal 'rider' (YLT); millstone reading kept as the tool paired with the mill.

notes.subject: חבל … חובל
notes.rationale: Same root opens and closes the verse — taking-in-pledge framing the whole law; the repetition is kept with 'misen' twice.

notes.subject: ni
notes.rationale: נפש rendered 'ni' (life/soul); here it means the debtor's livelihood — the mill grinds the bread that keeps him alive.

translation: Kelen si ta ⟨את⟩ murekabakurun fila ni ⟨את⟩ a sanfɛkabakurun ka kɛ misen ye, sabu ni de don min bɛ ta misen ye.
